propositions: AnthropicModel import fails in uv-provisioned environments because pydantic-ai-slim 1.38.0 (wrongly resolved by uv) depends on a UserLocation export from anthropic that exists only in 0.120.2+, not in older anthropic versions pulled by the stale resolution.

uv's universal resolution jointly locks all extras, causing a boto3 diamond: [eval] -> inspect-ai -> aiobotocore pins boto3 < 1.40.62, while pydantic-ai-slim[bedrock] requires boto3 >= 1.42.63, forcing uv to downgrade pydantic-ai-slim below 1.107.
pip-based installs (make install, Makefile [dev]) remain unaffected because pip resolves each extra set independently, never co-resolving the conflicting boto3 requirements.
Declaring [tool.uv] conflicts between eval and bedrock/dev extras allows uv to resolve pydantic-ai-slim >= 1.107 with compatible anthropic >= 0.120.
The fix requires updating pyproject.toml floors to pydantic-ai-slim[anthropic,retries]>=1.107,<2 and adding the conflicts block; no uv.lock commit is necessary since it is gitignored in this repo.
A CI smoke test must import pydantic_ai.models.anthropic.AnthropicModel to detect and prevent future resolution regressions.
